ndc_assessment.summary: "Ecuador intends to reduce its emissions in the energy sector in 20.4-25% below the BAU scenario. However, a potential for reducing emissions even further in the energy sector, to a level between 37.5 and 45.8% with respect to the BAU baseline has also been calculated. This potential could be harnessed in light of the appropriate circumstances in terms of availability of resources and support offered by the international community. This is a second scenario dependent upon international support and will translate into a per capita emissions reduction in 2025 of 40% below the BAU levels."
ndc_assessment.ghg_target: 20.4-25% (unconditional) to 37.5-45.8% (conditional) reduction in emissions in the energy sector by 2025 compared to the BAU scenario, equivalent to 40% reduction (conditional) in emissions per capita by 2025 compared to the BAU levels.

target_text.text: Ecuador ha diseñado su NDC considerando una serie de esfuerzos en líneas de acción e iniciativas correspondientes con un potencial de reducción de emisiones de gases de efecto invernadero, sobre la base de un análisis agregado que incluye a los sectores: Energía, Agricultura, Procesos Industriales y Residuos. El sector USCUSS ha sido analizado de manera separada debido a la diferencia en la metodología aplicada en relación con los otros cuatro sectores. Además, el Ecuador ha aplicado, de acuerdo con sus circunstancias nacionales, las Modalidades, Procedimientos y Guías (MPGs) para la construcción de su primera NDC.

verdict.text: Ecuador pledges a 7% reduction by 2035 against 2035 business-as-usual (unconditional). The registry's current submission for this Party is Second NDC, filed 2025-02-06. 52 observed values are loaded from DS-02 (11), DS-35 (35), DS-40 (6). For 2024 the sources disagree: DS-02 77.8 MtCO₂e, DS-35 63.1 MtCO₂e. They are on different inventory scopes and the engine does not reconcile them. No implementation gap is reported: the pledge is 7% below a business-as-usual projection for 2035. That projection is not in any source loaded here, so the percentage cannot be turned into a tonnage and the trend cannot be judged against it. It submitted BTR1. 4 of 8 components have been confirmed in the document; the rest are unparsed, which is not a finding against the country. ND-GAIN scores it 43.6 for 2024. In the first NDC round, WRI's CAIT assessment recorded: 20.4-25% (unconditional) to 37.5-45.8% (conditional) reduction in emissions in the energy sector by 2025 compared to the BAU scenario, equivalent to 40% reduction (conditional) in emissions per capita by 2025 compared to the BAU levels. It was classed both. That is a 2016 assessment of an earlier submission, not the target above. Projected warming for 2080-2099 against 1995-2014 ranges from +1.03°C under SSP1-2.6 to +4°C under SSP5-8.5. These are model runs, not observations.
